item.title: Good Society: Regency Romance and Ruin
item.description: Create your own Regency romance or scandal with the Good Society RPG bundle. Get the complete first edition for $17.95 ahead of the upcoming 2E Kickstarter from Storybrewers.

item.title: Cardyhedron Fold: The magnetic tri-fold spinner dice for roleplaying games
item.description: SmokyCreation brings the Cardyhedron Fold to Kickstarter. This magnetic tri-fold spinner device replaces traditional polyhedrals with smooth micro ball bearing dials.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #351
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons confirms the 2024 rules as version 5.5, while a major Fan Expo heads to London. Plus, Sirius Dice lands a Lord of the Rings licence, Modiphius announces a Wolfenstein roleplaying game, and the UK Ministry of Defence turns to world-building.

item.title: Audio EXP #324: D&D at The O2, Wolfenstein Roleplaying, and MoD Sci-Fi
item.description: Audio EXP 324 covers the Ministry of Defence using sci-fi writers to plan the future, D&D moving to a seasonal model, and the new Good Society bundle.

item.title: Tables to Tablets: How Iron Crown Enterprises is digitising 40 years of roleplaying history
item.description: Iron Crown Enterprises brings High Adventure Roleplaying (HARP) to Foundry and Roll20, bridging 40 years of crunch with modern digital automation for the fans.

item.title: Winnipeg Gothic: Kristin Kreuk and Peter Mooney unveil Black Star
item.description: Explore the hopeful yet bleak history of Winnipeg in Black Star, a new five-issue series from Titan Comics and Kristin Kreuk.

item.title: Storytelling Collective joins forces with DriveThruRPG for PocketQuest 2026 indie game jam
item.description: DriveThruRPG launches PocketQuest 2026, a 25-page tabletop design jam focused on Time Travel. Discover the new strict no-AI rule and exclusivity details.

item.title: Campaign Starters: 0one Games maps your next adventure
item.description: Start your next fantasy RPG campaign right. The 0one Campaign Starters bundle offers dozens of interactive, customizable .PDF maps for just $9.95.

item.title: Temeraire: The Roleplaying Game brings Napoleonic dragon riders to the tabletop
item.description: Magpie Games brings Naomi Novik's Temeraire novels to the tabletop. Play as dragons or aviators in the Napoleonic Wars. Back the Kickstarter today.

item.title: Street level or corporate giant? Sneak Energy takes on the Man Without Fear
item.description: Sneak Energy joins forces with Marvel for a Daredevil Born Again season 2 collaboration. We investigate if the brand has traded its street level roots for an Avengers level corporate suit.
